cart_orders.description: Look up, create, update, refund, and manage store orders, including their statuses, transactions, addresses, and disputes.
cart_orders.note: Order totals and amounts are integers in CENTS (e.g. 1200 = $12.00).

cart_products.description: Look up, create, update, delete, and bulk-edit store products, including search, duplication, taxonomy terms, and shipping/tax classes.
cart_products.note: cart_products_update: despite its /pricing API path this is the FULL product update and the only action that writes the product gallery/featured image — gallery is [{id, url, title}] where id is a WP media attachment ID, gallery[0] becomes the featured image, and an empty gallery [] deletes the thumbnail. post_title and post_status are set unconditionally, so always send them (omitting them blanks the stored values). Omit variants entirely unless you mean to rewrite them: item_price there is multiplied by 100 on write, so round-tripping read values inflates every price 100×.

cart_product_variants.description: Manage product variations: pricing, inventory and stock, bundles, upgrade paths, media, and variant search.
cart_product_variants.note: PRICE UNITS: despite the API docs' blanket 'cents' claim, variation create/update prices (item_price, compare_price) are plain DOLLARS — sending cents stores a 100× price; read back after writing to confirm. Stock updates expect a variants wrapper with total_stock/available (422 errors name the missing fields).

cart_product_assets.description: Manage products' downloadable files and per-product integration feeds.

cart_customers.description: Look up, create, update, and manage store customers, their addresses, purchase stats, and linked WordPress users.

cart_coupons.description: Manage discount coupons: create, update, delete, apply to or remove from orders, and check product eligibility.

cart_subscriptions.description: View and manage recurring subscriptions: cancel, re-sync from the payment gateway, switch payment methods, and handle early payments.

cart_tax.description: Manage tax classes, tax rates, per-country configuration, EU VAT/OSS overrides, and order tax records.

cart_shipping.description: Manage shipping zones, shipping methods, and shipping classes.

cart_settings.description: Read or update store settings: general store options, modules and addons, permissions, payment methods, storage drivers, and checkout fields.

cart_email_notifications.description: Manage the store's transactional email templates, global email settings, reminders, and previews.

cart_reports.description: Read-only store analytics: revenue, orders, products, customers, subscriptions, refunds, licenses, and dashboard summaries.

cart_integrations.description: Manage global integration feeds and provider settings, and install or activate integration addons.

cart_files.description: List, upload, and delete files in the store's configured storage drivers.

cart_labels_attributes.description: Manage store labels and product attribute groups and their terms.

cart_utilities.description: Store utilities: dashboard stats and onboarding, activity log, order notes, print templates, country data, filter options, and retention snapshots; saved list views (filters) for the admin UI.

cart_storefront.description: Read-only public storefront data: published products, rendered product listings, and product search — no authentication required.

cart_checkout.description: Checkout-session operations: place an order, fetch payment and shipping info for the cart, and log a customer in.
cart_checkout.note: These endpoints expect a customer browser session (cookie + nonce); most will be rejected under Application Password auth — see docs/api-reference/auth.md.

cart_customer_portal.description: Customer-portal operations on the logged-in customer's own profile, orders, addresses, subscriptions, and downloads.
cart_customer_portal.note: These endpoints expect a customer browser session (cookie + nonce); most will be rejected under Application Password auth — see docs/api-reference/auth.md.

cart_licensing.description: Manage software licenses: view, extend, regenerate keys, change limits, activate or deactivate sites, plus the public license verification endpoints (FluentCart Pro).

cart_roles.description: Manage FluentCart shop roles, permissions, and user assignments (FluentCart Pro).

cart_order_bumps.description: Manage checkout order bumps: list, create, update, and delete (FluentCart Pro).

cart_inventory.description: Stock across all products and variants: list and stats, single and bulk stock updates, adjustment history, and inventory export.
cart_inventory.note: bulk_update_stock rewrites stock levels for many variants in one call and is confirm-gated; update_stock changes one.

cart_data_export.description: Batch data exports of customers, orders, subscriptions and licenses, plus the export schema (available columns) for each.
cart_data_export.note: Exports are paged batches: read the schema first, then call the batch export repeatedly with the offset it returns.

cart_pdf_templates.description: PDF receipt/invoice templates: list, get, save and delete templates, factory defaults, PDF engine status, preview download, and the seller details printed on documents.

products/update-product-pricing.summary: Update Product (post fields, detail, variants, gallery/featured image)

settings/install-plugin-addon.bodyNote: Privilege/code change: Installs new plugin code on the site. Requires confirm:true.

settings/activate-plugin-addon.bodyNote: Privilege/code change: Activates plugin code on the site. Requires confirm:true.

settings/install-payment-addon.bodyNote: Privilege/code change: Installs new plugin code on the site. Requires confirm:true.

settings/activate-payment-addon.bodyNote: Privilege/code change: Activates plugin code on the site. Requires confirm:true.

integration/install-addon-plugin.bodyNote: Privilege/code change: Installs and activates plugin code on the site. Requires confirm:true.

settings/save-permissions.bodyNote: Privilege/code change: Rewrites who may manage the store. Requires confirm:true.

customers/attach-user.bodyNote: Privilege/code change: Links a customer record to a WordPress login. Requires confirm:true.

orders/charge-now.bodyNote: Charges the subscription's stored payment method immediately and creates a renewal order. Real money moves. Requires confirm:true.

orders/create-renewal-now.bodyNote: Creates the next renewal order/invoice now (and charges it where the gateway supports it). Requires confirm:true.

orders/skip-renewal.bodyNote: Skips the subscription's next billing period — changes what the customer is charged. Requires confirm:true.

orders/void-renewal.bodyNote: Voids a renewal invoice so it will not be collected. Requires confirm:true.

products/bulk-update-variants.bodyNote: Rewrites fields on many variants at once. Prices are plain DOLLARS here (see cart_product_variants note). Requires confirm:true.

products/group-bulk-update-variants.bodyNote: Rewrites fields on every variant in the selected groups. Requires confirm:true.

inventory/bulk-update-stock.bodyNote: Rewrites stock levels for many variants in one call. Read cart_inventory_list first. Requires confirm:true.

dashboard/run-data-backfills.bodyNote: Runs pending data migrations/backfills over the store's tables. Take a backup first. Requires confirm:true.

settings/install-mcp-adapter.bodyNote: Installs and activates the WordPress MCP Adapter plugin on the site (adds and runs new code). Requires confirm:true.

settings/toggle-mcp.bodyNote: Enables/disables FluentCart's own MCP tools on the site — a second AI control surface. Requires confirm:true.

customer-profile/pause-subscription.bodyNote: Pauses the customer's subscription (stops renewals until resumed). Acts as the configured user's customer profile. Requires confirm:true.

orders/change-customer.bodyNote: Money/ownership: changes who an order belongs to or marks it paid without a payment. Requires confirm:true.

orders/create-and-change-customer.bodyNote: Money/ownership: changes who an order belongs to or marks it paid without a payment. Requires confirm:true.

orders/mark-as-paid.bodyNote: Money/ownership: changes who an order belongs to or marks it paid without a payment. Requires confirm:true.

products/bulk-insert-products.bodyNote: Bulk write: changes many products at once. Requires confirm:true.

products/bulk-update-products.bodyNote: Bulk write: changes many products at once. Requires confirm:true.

settings/save-payment-method-settings.bodyNote: Checkout change: reconfigures a live payment method. Requires confirm:true.

email-notification/send-manual-reminder.bodyNote: Sends a message to a real customer that cannot be recalled. Requires confirm:true.

licensing/extend-license-validity.bodyNote: Licensing: changes a customer's license status, activation limit or expiry. Requires confirm:true.

licensing/update-license-activation-limi.bodyNote: Licensing: changes a customer's license status, activation limit or expiry. Requires confirm:true.

licensing/update-license-status.bodyNote: Licensing: changes a customer's license status, activation limit or expiry. Requires confirm:true.

roles-permissions/assign-role.bodyNote: Privilege change: grants or changes a store manager role. Requires confirm:true.

roles-permissions/update-role.bodyNote: Privilege change: grants or changes a store manager role. Requires confirm:true.
